messages:
alex: quick idea — add a "quiet schedule affinity" layer to notify routing so alerts tied to tenant SLOs can be attenuated during known noisy windows (backups, batch jobs)

sam: curious - is this a UI-only shim or a routing policy change?

aj: a routing policy + small API extension. tia for quick thoughts.

alex: plan: 1) tag SLOs with affinity groups (e.g. maintenance-window, timezone-peak) 2) attach a schedule that lowers notify fanout & increases sampling during the window 3) surface schedule in console so owners can override

jamie: need to be careful w/ UX — owners should see exact behavior not just "muted". show preview of expected fanout reduction and example recipients that would be skipped.

lee: product + legal concern — we mustn’t accidentally suppress P0 alerts. exclusion list required.

sam: +1 on exclusion list. also telemetry must record suppressed count, reason, and which fallback (sampling vs full block) applied.

alex: agreed. telemetry fields proposed: "suppressed_count", "suppression_reason", "applied_policy", "preview_fanout_ratio". sends to notify-telemetry pipeline.

jamie: can we get a tiny API sketch? easier to review.

alex: pasted example payload:```json
{
  "slo_id": "slo_42",
  "affinity_group": "maintenance-window",
  "schedule": {
    "tz": "UTC",
    "windows": [{"start": "23:00", "end": "03:00", "days": ["mon","tue","wed"]}]
  },
  "policy": {"mode":"attenuate","fanout_ratio":0.2,"exclude_levels":["P0","P1"]}
}
```

sam: looks good. two asks: 1) ensure policy validation server-side (no fanout_ratio > 1, exclude_levels must exist) 2) make it unary-change compatible for rollouts (old clients ignore unknown fields)

lee: on console copy — show small "what happens during this schedule" card with sample recipients and an "enforce/preview" toggle. default to preview for first 48h.

jamie: implementation note — frontend needs an endpoint that returns estimated notify recipients pre- and post-policy for preview. that needs per-tenant sampling sim. heavy but doable async.

alex: rollout plan: feature-flagged API + UI, start with internal tenants, gather suppressed telemetry for 2 weeks, then default-preview to customers, then opt-in enforce later. ops-bot: can you add a Grafana dashboard panel for suppressed_count and preview_fanout_ratio? @ops-bot

ops-bot: ticket created: INF-8245 — Dashboard panel for "SLO suppression" metrics.

sam: one more: alerting console must still show a message in incident view that an alert was suppressed by quiet-schedule to avoid confusion. link to runbook.

alex: yes — add a small inline banner on the alert flyout: "Suppressed by Quiet Schedule (maintenance-window). Details -> [link]"

lee: what about per-tenant quotas? attenuating fanout may change quota accounting. we should surface estimated token spend reduction as well.

alex: good call — telemetry will also emit "estimated_token_savings" for each suppression event. show that in the preview card.

jamie: dev note — sample endpoint signature: `GET /v1/slo/:id/preview-suppression?window=2026-03-01-2026-03-08` returns `{original_recipients, estimated_after, token_savings}`. we can paginate.

sam: ops question — how do we handle multi-zone windows? e.g. tenant operates global infra with different busy periods.

alex: allow multiple schedule entries per affinity and evaluate against request's timezone metadata (or tenant default). fallback to UTC.

lee: UX wrinkle — onboarding should surface recommended affinity groups based on historical alert spikes. can we add a simple ML job to suggest groups? low priority but nice.

alex: note for API team: must be backward compatible. if a client posts an unknown affinity, backend should store it but ignore for older routing tiers. also admin override API to lift suppression on specific active incidents.

sam: SGTM. let's document validation rules + rollout checklist. i'll make a short RFC PR.

jamie: I'll mock the preview card and wire the sample endpoint.

lee: I'll draft console copy and the recommended default preview period.

alex: thanks all. RFC link when ready — calling this a proposal for now. :thumbsup:

sam: small nit — include owner notification when a suppression is first created for their SLO (one-time email). prevents surprise.

alex: yep — add "owner_notification": true default in payload.

ops-bot: INF-8245 updated with notes about suppression telemetry.
